newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa tops German air cargo survey.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa tops German air cargo survey.

text.p: German shippers and forwarders see Lufthansa Cargo AG as the closest to an ideal cargo airline, an industry survey showed.
The Lufthansa-commissioned survey of 200 German air cargo clients by research organisation Infratest Burke showed the airline scored highly for prestige and quality.
KLM Royal Dutch Airlines was given high marks for innovation, while Air France and Korean Airlines were picked out on price.
Cargolux was the best for service, ahead of TNT Worldwide Express, DHL International and Cathay Pacific.
British Airways was identified as "conservative" in the survey.
Lufthansa Cargo said it is now researching its image in selected international markets. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
